summary: Solver correctly localized the problem to the IAM policy file and made meaningful edits including removing cognito:* wildcard and adding route table, network ACL, and flow logs permissions. However, the solver over-corrected by removing cognito-idp:* (which fix.patch keeps) and failed to consolidate individual VPC endpoint actions under the new wildcards. Oracle verifier uses behavioral tests that correctly identify these implementation pattern issues.
evidence: Solver identified and edited terraform/environments/bootstrap/member-bootstrap/iam.tf which matches fix.patch target file
